[b]The supplier[/b]

A team of Sal-Baliz soldiers were waiting at one of the border outposts, when they recieve a transmission from the high command.
"The suppliers are here. The money is hidden in the basement, you must get the supplies, before giving them the money." The soldiers searched through the basement of the outpost and found a briefcase full of 5 million tabhuts. They proceeded to carry it outside, where three large supply trucks were waiting. two masked individuals stepped out of the first truck. "Greetings from [REDACTED]" the first one said. "We have your supplies, we better make this quick before we get caught."
"Agreed, here is your payment. You may take it when the supplies are off loaded." said the commanding soldier. A large group of the [REDACTED] men began hauling missiles, rifles and aircraft out of the three trucks. It took around 2 hours to do, but eventually all of the supplies where ready to be taken to Sal-Baliz compounds across the desert.
"Pleasure doing business with you," the second masked individual said as the money was handed over.
